long_biography.plain_text:
When investor Alexander Mamut bought Waterstones in 2011, he appointed independent bookseller James Daunt to run the struggling chain. Under his ownership, Daunt gave individual shops greater control over their stock and displays. The business returned to profit before Mamut sold a majority stake to Elliott seven years later.

Mamut approached Moscow's Pioner cinema as a place to experiment with film festivals, a bookshop and a café. Its team curated a programme of international cinema, and the venue dispensed with popcorn. He subsequently combined Cinema Park and Formula Kino into Russia's largest cinema chain.
long_biography.html:
When investor Alexander Mamut bought Waterstones in 2011, he appointed independent bookseller James Daunt to run the struggling chain.
